Pi Xiu . TunTun
—— Not out
Pi Xiu, ancient beast.
It has the innate ability to attract wealth and treasures.
Tuntun, alongside Tao Tie Jing, serves as one of the coordinators of TinFun Street.

Responsible for overseeing the flow of wealth and acting as the manager of the "Phantom Market."
It often engages in fierce disputes with Jile over precious artifacts, leading to the breaking of one of its horns.
Recently, it seems that a mysterious individual has forged a new mechanical horn for it.
饕餮 · 净
Tao Tie . Jing
—— In only
Tao Tie, ancient behemoth.
It is known for its insatiable greed and love for food.
Its ravenous appetite often gives away its true identity, as it can't resist the enticing aroma of food. This often leads to hasty retreats and creates numerous troubles in its wake.

Citizens who have long resided in TinFun claim to have encountered the TaoTie creature, which bears no resemblance to Jing's friendly appearance.
Occasionally, it plays mischievous pranks on intruders, responsible for purifying the thoughts of those who come and go in TinFun Street.
This is a mysterious city
"Round heaven and square earth."
This is a blessed land bestowed by the Qilin, a mysterious city known as the "Round heaven and square earth."
Water weaves its way through the buildings and eaves, sometimes rushing, sometimes rippling.
It serves as a barrier, yet also acts as a connection.
Guarding the city are towering statues of gods and buddhas, their features and forms indiscernible.

As the central hub of TinFun Street, the Water Hub is an undeniable presence within the entire city.

The architecture is characterized by soft curves and circular forms, with the streets arranged around the Chongyuan Tower, reminiscent of the grandeur of ancient Chang'an.

It serves as the gathering place for the residents of TinFun, and during the auspicious days of Qilin's blessings, the streets are bustling with people, eager to witness the spectacle.
